open.text: OorjaMan — professional solar panel cleaning, one connected platform.

beats.text: On the left, the customer. On the right, the field partner.
The customer books a visit — chooses a day, a time, and pays after service.
Operations assigns a verified partner. The job appears in the technician queue.
Both apps stay aligned on Job Start and finish codes.
On site, the partner starts the visit — safety, a start selfie, then the job timer.
Before and after photos capture proof of work.
The partner submits the finish code. The visit completes on both sides.
